view.name: 3D explorer main view
view.description: Main 3D solar system view orbiting Earth with the time panel, celestial directory with search and categories, target info card, navigation HUD and compass.

regions.label: Full-bleed 3D scene: Earth sphere, orbit lines, star field, labelled bodies and bright stars
Simulated date/time with time warp and keycap shortcuts ([ slower, ] faster, P pause, N now)
Directory 'click to fly': search field plus collapsible category groups (Stars, Planets, Moons, Comets, TNOs, Probes, Tours) with counts
Explore mode HUD: mode hint, audio state, orbiting / nearest body with altitude, F/T shortcut keycaps, HD texture loading percentage
Selected body detail: name with Chinese name, distance/light-time, physical and orbital properties, description, 'Did you know' fact with Another, Fly there
Circular compass with N/S/E/W and Sun/Earth markers

evidence.note: Textured 3D Earth globe in a full-bleed WebGL scene with anchored body label
Camera controls described: drag, scroll, double-click to fly; free flight
Compass orientation widget floating over the scene

patterns.rationale: Codebook entry is about inspecting an object; here the 3D scene is a navigable solar system (space explorer), closest fit. Live check: clicking Mars flew camera to Mars and updated info panel; help overlay (H) lists first-person/surface walk modes.

evidence.note: Directory list of bodies grouped by category; clicking a body (verified live with Mars) flies to it and updates detail panel
Detail view with all attributes of selected body
details/summary groups with ▶/▼ triangles, emoji type icons and counts; Planets expanded showing 8 indented body buttons; Mars highlighted when selected live
Search input with magnifier emoji in placeholder, filled #142034 with thin border
Small text-only percentage for HD texture streaming; scene stays usable
Keycap shortcut hints printed beside the time controls
evidence.quote: [ slower ] faster P pause N now

evidence.note: Always-visible interaction hints and keycaps; canvas aria label says 'H for help' (shortcut overlay verified live)
evidence.quote: F Free flight T Go to selected

evidence.note: Spatial explorer but astronomical 3D scene, not a geographic basemap
Collapsible groups coded as tree-view instead (grouped hierarchical directory of items)

patterns.rationale: Directory groups are details/summary disclosures that could also be read as an accordion; coded as tree-view.

structure.layout: full-bleed 3D WebGL viewport filling the 1440x900 screen with floating translucent HUD panels: time-warp panel top-left, collapsible body directory below it, explore/status HUD bottom-left, body info panel top-right, compass bottom-right; no scrolling

aesthetics.typography: Single sans stack declared as Microsoft YaHei (renders as system sans/DejaVu) for all HUD text, mixing English names with smaller Chinese names; Arial in search input; monospace-like keycap boxes for shortcuts
aesthetics.typeScale: Compact HUD scale: 17px bold body title / date, 16px bold panel headers, 13px body rows, 11-12px muted secondary and Chinese names, 10px labels; weight contrast (bold titles vs regular rows) carries hierarchy

notes: Space-sim HUD aesthetic: near-black translucent navy panels (#08101c) with 1px borders and 6-10px radii float over a live WebGL star field; colored orbit lines streak across the scene. Bilingual labels (English + smaller grey Chinese 地球/火星). Keyboard-first: keycap-boxed shortcut letters inline in panels, a full shortcut sheet behind H (not visible in capture). Category icons are emoji. Info panel ends with a green-tinted 'Did you know' fact callout with left green border and 'Another ↻' rotate link, plus 'T Fly there'. Real-time simulated clock with time warp. 'Tours' group suggests guided camera tours.
